8078    /// Issue 1667 — release a GUARD CONDITION entry: its callback is dropped and
8079    /// `spin_once` stops polling it; the slot and its arena bytes go to the next
8080    /// registration.
8081    ///
8082    /// Unlike the other release verbs this one has a contract a generation
8083    /// cannot discharge. The [`GuardCondition`] trigger handle holds a pointer
8084    /// to the flag INSIDE the entry, and it is `Clone` + `Send`, so a clone on
8085    /// another thread (an ISR, a worker) would write into whatever reuses those
8086    /// bytes. The C++ `GuardCondition` is non-copyable and the one holder of its
8087    /// trigger handle, which is why its destructor can call this.
8088    ///
8089    /// # Safety
8090    /// No [`GuardCondition`] trigger handle for this entry — the one
8091    /// registration returned, or any clone of it — may be used afterwards.
8092    pub(crate) unsafe fn release_guard_condition(&mut self, handle: HandleId) -> bool {
8093        match self.resolve_handle(handle) {
8094            Some(slot) => unsafe { self.release_entry(slot, EntryKind::GuardCondition) },
8095            None => false,
8096        }
8097    }
8098
8099    /// Find the next free entry slot index.
8100    pub(crate) fn next_entry_slot(&self) -> Result<usize, NodeError> {
8101        self.entries
8102            .iter()
8103            .position(|e| e.is_none())
8104            // Issue 0095 — the callback-entry table (`NROS_EXECUTOR_MAX_CBS`,
8105            // default 4) is full. Distinct from `BufferTooSmall` so the register
8106            // seam can tell the user to raise the knob.
8107            .ok_or(NodeError::ExecutorFull)
8108    }
8109
8110    /// Install a finished [`CallbackMeta`] into its slot.
8111    ///
8112    /// phase-8 (`docs/design/callback_tracing.rst`) — the ONE choke point
8113    /// every registration site funnels through, so the
8114    /// `nros_callback_register(handle, kind, name)` event is emitted once,
8115    /// here, rather than at the 25 sites that build a `CallbackMeta`. The
8116    /// design's registration half is deliberately EXHAUSTIVE across every
8117    /// `EntryKind` even though the leaf hooks are staged: a callback that was
8118    /// registered but never observed then prints as "registered, not
8119    /// instrumented" instead of being silently absent, so an incomplete hook
8120    /// set announces itself in the output rather than looking like a
8121    /// measurement.
8122    ///
8123    /// It is the assignment — not [`next_entry_slot`](Self::next_entry_slot)
8124    /// — because a slot is claimed BEFORE the fallible work (session lookup,
8125    /// arena allocation, handle creation) that can still return `Err`.
8126    /// Emitting at slot-claim time would announce callbacks that do not
8127    /// exist.
8128    pub(crate) fn emplace_entry(
8129        &mut self,
8130        slot: usize,
8131        mut meta: CallbackMeta,
8132        name: TraceName<'_>,
8133    ) {
8134        // Issue 1631 — record the region the entry's allocation handed out,
8135        // so `release_entry` gives back exactly that. Matched on the OFFSET so
8136        // a stale region (a registration that failed after allocating) is
8137        // never attributed to a different entry.
8138        meta.arena_len = match self.pending_region.take() {
8139            Some(r) if r.offset == meta.offset => super::arena::ArenaLen::new(r.len),
8140            _ => super::arena::ArenaLen::UNRECORDED,
8141        };
8142        trace_register(slot, meta.kind, name);
8143        // phase10-B3 -- a subscription on a route's trigger topic is the
8144        // route's trigger. The table is installed before any node exists.
8145        if let (EntryKind::Subscription, TraceName::Text(topic)) = (meta.kind, &name) {
8146            super::monitor::route_bind(self.monitor_table, topic, slot);
8147        }
8148        // phase-463 W7 — the slot's identity for the host profile, keyed on the
8149        // arena base the dispatch sees (stable for the executor's life).
8150        #[cfg(feature = "profile-mode")]
8151        super::profile::on_register(self.arena.as_ptr() as usize, slot, meta.kind, name);
8152        self.entries[slot] = Some(meta);
8153        // Issue 2018 -- the registering level's own context (0, the default,
8154        // when it has none); a node or group binding still overrides it.
8155        if let Some(b) = self.sched_context_bindings.get_mut(slot) {
8156            *b = super::sched_context::SchedContextId(self.worker.registering_sched);
8157        }
8158        // phase-476 W0 — a new occupant gets a new generation, so every handle
8159        // issued for the slot's previous occupant stops resolving. Owner is
8160        // cleared; a registration made for a node sets it after this
8161        // (`set_entry_owner`).
8162        if let Some(tag) = self.slot_tags.get_mut(slot) {
8163            tag.generation = tag.next_generation();
8164            tag.owner = 0;
8165            tag.rank = 0;
8166            // phase-509 P9b item 4 -- the level being set up owns it.
8167            tag.level = self.worker.registering_level;
8168            tag.reset_flags();
8169        }
8170    }
8171
8172    /// phase-397 W2 — register `slot`'s entity with THIS executor's wake
8173    /// context, through `register` (the entry handle's `register_waker`).
8174    ///
8175    /// Called by every subscription, service and client registration AFTER
8176    /// the entry is written into the arena: the handle's address is stable
8177    /// from then on, and a backend that keeps a pointer into the handle (the
8178    /// cffi route's per-entity `user_data`) must not see it move.
8179    ///
8180    /// Records whether the backend accepted it in `entity_attributed`. A
8181    /// backend that cannot attribute an arrival returns `false`, and the
8182    /// session-scoped wake keeps covering that entry. Without the async wake
8183    /// primitive, or without `rmw-cffi`, there is nothing to wake and this does
8184    /// nothing.
8185    #[allow(unused_variables, unused_mut)]
8186    pub(crate) fn arm_entity_wake(
8187        &mut self,
8188        slot: usize,
8189        register: impl FnOnce(&core::task::Waker) -> bool,
8190    ) {
8191        #[cfg(all(feature = "alloc", feature = "rmw-cffi"))]
8192        {
8193            if self.node_wake.is_none() || slot >= super::entity_wake::SLOTS {
8194                return;
8195            }
8196            self.wake_ctx_ptr();
8197            let Some(waker) = self
8198                .wake_ctx
8199                .as_ref()
8200                .and_then(|ctx| super::entity_wake::waker(ctx, slot))
8201            else {
8202                return;
8203            };
8204            let bit = 1u64 << slot;
8205            if register(&waker) {
8206                self.entity_attributed |= bit;
8207                // W3 — the backend replays nothing that arrived before this
8208                // call, so the first spin asks `has_data` once.
8209                self.entity_recheck |= bit;
8210            } else {
8211                self.entity_attributed &= !bit;
8212                self.entity_recheck &= !bit;
8213            }
8214        }
8215    }
8216
8217    /// [`arm_entity_wake`](Self::arm_entity_wake) for the entry of type `T`
8218    /// at arena `offset`: the one place a registration site's entry is read
8219    /// back to reach its handle.
8220    ///
8221    /// # Safety
8222    ///
8223    /// A `T` was written at `offset` and is the live occupant of `slot`. It
8224    /// stays at that address until its release, which drops the handle (and
8225    /// with it the backend's registration) first.
8226    pub(crate) unsafe fn arm_entry_wake<T>(
8227        &mut self,
8228        slot: usize,
8229        offset: usize,
8230        register: impl FnOnce(&T, &core::task::Waker) -> bool,
8231    ) {
8232        let entry = self
8233            .arena
8234            .as_ptr()
8235            .cast::<u8>()
8236            .wrapping_add(offset)
8237            .cast::<T>();
8238        // SAFETY: the caller's contract — a live `T` at `offset`.
8239        self.arm_entity_wake(slot, |w| register(unsafe { &*entry }, w));
8240    }
8241
8242    /// phase-397 W2 — the ready word, taken: every slot an attributed arrival
8243    /// marked since the last take. `spin_once` consumes it (W3), so a caller
8244    /// that also spins sees only what arrived since the last spin. Tests only.
8245    #[doc(hidden)]
8246    pub fn take_entity_ready_bits(&self) -> u64 {
8247        #[cfg(all(feature = "alloc", feature = "rmw-cffi"))]
8248        if let Some(ctx) = self.wake_ctx.as_ref() {
8249            return ctx.ready.swap(0, core::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst) as u64;
8250        }
8251        0
8252    }
8253
8254    /// phase-397 W2 — the slots whose backend accepted an entity waker.
8255    #[doc(hidden)]
8256    pub fn entity_attributed_slots(&self) -> u64 {
8257        #[cfg(all(feature = "alloc", feature = "rmw-cffi"))]
8258        return self.entity_attributed;
8259        #[cfg(not(all(feature = "alloc", feature = "rmw-cffi")))]
8260        0
8261    }
8262
8263    /// phase-397 W3 — how many `has_data` calls the readiness scan has made
8264    /// (wrapping). An attributed slot's readiness comes from its arrival bit,
8265    /// so a spin over attributed entries alone adds nothing here. Tests only;
8266    /// `0` in a build with no entity wake, where it is not counted.
8267    #[doc(hidden)]
8268    pub fn readiness_probe_count(&self) -> u32 {
8269        #[cfg(all(feature = "alloc", feature = "rmw-cffi"))]
8270        return self.readiness_probes;
8271        #[cfg(not(all(feature = "alloc", feature = "rmw-cffi")))]
8272        0
8273    }
8274
8275    /// phase-509 P3 (RFC-0108 D2) -- probe the slots whose backend cannot
8276    /// attribute an arrival (XRCE, uORB) after every callback, so one made
8277    /// ready by a callback runs in the same pass, in rank order, instead of
8278    /// at the next pass's scan. Pushed readiness joins mid-pass either way.
8279    /// The default is `REPROBE_EACH_CALLBACK_DEFAULT` (in `executor/spin.rs`); the phase-509 P3
8280    /// host measurement that chose it is recorded beside that constant.
8281    pub fn set_reprobe_each_callback(&mut self, on: bool) {
8282        self.reprobe_each_callback = on;
8283    }
8284
8285    /// phase-476 W0 — the handle for the CURRENT occupant of `slot`. Every
8286    /// registration returns this, after `emplace_entry` has stamped the slot.
8287    pub(crate) fn handle_for(&self, slot: usize) -> HandleId {
8288        let generation = self.slot_tags.get(slot).map_or(0, |t| t.generation);
8289        HandleId::new(slot, generation)
8290    }
8291
8292    /// phase-476 W0 (issue 1667) — the slot `id` names, if and only if `id` was
8293    /// issued for the entry that occupies it NOW. A handle whose entry was
8294    /// released, or whose slot has since been taken by another registration of
8295    /// any kind, answers `None`, never the next occupant.
8296    pub fn resolve_handle(&self, id: HandleId) -> Option<usize> {
8297        let slot = id.slot();
8298        let live = self.entries.get(slot).is_some_and(|e| e.is_some())
8299            && self
8300                .slot_tags
8301                .get(slot)
8302                .is_none_or(|t| t.flags() & super::types::SlotTag::RELEASE_PENDING == 0);
8303        // Generation 0 is `HandleId::for_owned_slot`: a uniquely-owned holder
8304        // naming its own live slot. Every ISSUED handle carries >= 1.
8305        let current = id.generation() == 0
8306            || self
8307                .slot_tags
8308                .get(slot)
8309                .is_some_and(|t| t.generation == id.generation());
8310        (live && current).then_some(slot)
8311    }
8312
8313    /// Issue 1703 — the slot behind a by-index accessor's `entry_index`
8314    /// argument, which callers hand in in TWO spellings: a bare slot (nros-c's
8315    /// stored `arena_entry_index`, `node_runtime`'s resolved slot, an action's
8316    /// owned slot) or the PACKED handle an FFI issued (`HandleId::to_raw`,
8317    /// what nros-cpp's `handle_id_` and nros-c's `subscription.handle_id`
8318    /// hold since phase-476 W0). A bare slot has generation 0, so both decode
8319    /// through [`HandleId::from_raw`] and resolve here: the slot for a live
8320    /// entry, generation-checked when one was issued, `None` for a stale or
8321    /// foreign handle.
8322    ///
8323    /// The five accessors indexed `entries` with the argument as given. W0 made
8324    /// the FFI value a packed `(generation << 16) | slot`, so every packed
8325    /// caller read past the table and got `None` — `async_send_request` on a
8326    /// C++ callback client returned `INVALID_ARGUMENT` on every call, and the
8327    /// granted-QoS read-backs answered for no entity.
8328    fn slot_of_raw(&self, entry_index: usize) -> Option<usize> {
8329        self.resolve_handle(HandleId::from_raw(entry_index))
8330            .filter(|&slot| !self.running_elsewhere(slot))
8331    }
8332
8333    /// phase-476 W0 — [`resolve_handle`](Self::resolve_handle) as an index that
8334    /// is OUT OF RANGE for a stale handle, so an existing `entries.get(..)`
8335    /// chain answers `None` for it with no further change.
8336    ///
8337    /// phase-509 P9b item 2 -- also out of range while the entry's callback
8338    /// runs in another thread's window (`running_elsewhere`): the accessors
8339    /// that go through here touch the entry's arena data, which that callback
8340    /// owns until it returns. The caller sees what a stale handle gets, and
8341    /// may retry once the callback has returned.
8342    pub(crate) fn live_slot(&self, id: HandleId) -> usize {
8343        self.resolve_handle(id)
8344            .filter(|&slot| !self.running_elsewhere(slot))
8345            .unwrap_or(usize::MAX)
8346    }
8347
8348    /// phase-476 W0 — record that `node` registered the entry `id` names, so
8349    /// [`release_node`](Self::release_node) can find it. `false` when `id` is
8350    /// stale.
8351    pub(crate) fn set_entry_owner(&mut self, id: HandleId, node: crate::executor::NodeId) -> bool {
8352        let Some(slot) = self.resolve_handle(id) else {
8353            return false;
8354        };
8355        let Ok(biased) = u8::try_from(node.index() + 1) else {
8356            return false;
8357        };
8358        self.slot_tags[slot].owner = biased;
8359        true
8360    }
8361
8362    /// phase-476 W0 — release every entry `node` registered, whatever its kind.
8363    /// Returns how many were released.
8364    ///
8365    /// This is what a node's destruction calls. A C++ callback's capture is
8366    /// copied into the arena and commonly holds the node's `this`, so an entry
8367    /// that outlived its node would dispatch into freed memory.
8368    ///
8369    /// # Safety
8370    /// No handle to any of those entries may be used afterwards except through
8371    /// a lookup that checks the generation ([`resolve_handle`](Self::resolve_handle)),
8372    /// which every public lookup on this type does.
8373    pub(crate) unsafe fn release_node(&mut self, node: crate::executor::NodeId) -> usize {
8374        let Ok(biased) = u8::try_from(node.index() + 1) else {
8375            return 0;
8376        };
8377        let mut released = 0;
8378        for slot in 0..self.entries.len() {
8379            if self.slot_tags.get(slot).is_some_and(|t| t.owner == biased) {
8380                let kind = match self.entries[slot].as_ref() {
8381                    Some(m) => m.kind,
8382                    None => continue,
8383                };
8384                // SAFETY: forwarded from this function's contract.
8385                if unsafe { self.release_entry(slot, kind) } {
8386                    released += 1;
8387                }
8388            }
8389        }
8390        released
8391    }
8392
8393    /// Open a subscription: claim a slot, resolve the node's identity, create
8394    /// the backend subscriber, and answer the in-place question ONCE.
8395    ///
8396    /// **phase-456 W8 — the one prologue.** Every registration that creates its
8397    /// own subscriber goes through here, in every language. The two callers
8398    /// that do not are the two that cannot: `add_arena_subscription_callback`
8399    /// is handed a subscriber someone else built (uORB needs a
8400    /// `&'static orb_metadata`, which no `TopicInfo` can express), so there is
8401    /// no topic to resolve and no session to reach — a fourth axis under issue
8402    /// 1319's rows that W8's three-axis decomposition did not predict: WHO
8403    /// CREATED THE SUBSCRIBER. It is a real axis, it is orthogonal to the other
8404    /// three, and it has exactly one member.
8405    ///
8406    /// Everything downstream of this function differs per delivery shape: the
8407    /// arena entry's type, its `try_process`, and whether it has a receive
8408    /// region at all. That part is irreducible and stays at the call site.
8409    pub(crate) fn open_subscription(
8410        &mut self,
8411        req: &SubscriptionRequest<'_>,
8412    ) -> Result<SubscriptionOpen, NodeError> {
8413        let slot = self.next_entry_slot()?;
8414        let (node_name, ns, session_idx) = match req.node_id {
8415            Some(id) => {
8416                let r = self
8417                    .nodes
8418                    .get(id.index())
8419                    .ok_or(NodeError::InvalidSchedContextBinding)?;
8420                (r.name.clone(), r.namespace.clone(), r.session_idx)
8421            }
8422            None => (self.node_name.clone(), self.namespace.clone(), 0u8),
8423        };
8424        let mut topic = TopicInfo::new(req.topic_name, req.type_name, req.type_hash)
8425            .with_domain(self.domain_id)
8426            .with_namespace(&ns);
8427        if !node_name.is_empty() {
8428            topic = topic.with_node_name(&node_name);
8429        }
8430        // Phase 231 (RFC-0038) / phase-402 W2 — hand the backend a
8431        // receive-buffer size so it can size-class its receive storage
8432        // (zenoh-pico: small vs large). Only when the caller actually stated
8433        // one: `with_rx_buffer_hint(0)` would be a claim of "zero bytes", not
8434        // "no opinion".
8435        if let Some(hint) = req.backend_hint {
8436            if hint != 0 {
8437                topic = topic.with_rx_buffer_hint(hint);
8438            }
8439        }
8440        // phase-454 W10/W13 — the depth this registration asks for against the
8441        // depth this system DECLARED for the topic. Before the backend call AND
8442        // before the arena claim, so the region this registration takes and the
8443        // one the build reserved are the same number; unchanged when nothing
8444        // was declared, which is every image with no contract sidecar. See
8445        // `declared_qos::honour` for why Rust TAKES the declared depth where C
8446        // and C++ assert it at the call site.
8447        //
8448        // phase-456 W8 — this used to be `declared_qos::check` here and
8449        // `honour` in each of the twelve hand-rolled prologues this function
8450        // replaced. Collapsing them onto `check` would have silently reverted
8451        // W13 for every Rust registration: `check` validates and returns, while
8452        // `honour` REWRITES the depth the backend is then given. One consulting
8453        // site is the point of this function, and it has to be the honouring
8454        // one.
8455        let qos = crate::declared_qos::honour(topic.type_name, topic.name, req.qos)?;
8456        let age_table = self.age_table;
8457        let (handle, deadline_row) = {
8458            let session = self
8459                .session_at_mut(session_idx)
8460                .ok_or(NodeError::BackendMismatch)?;
8461            // phase-462 W5b — a contract `deadline` the backend cannot judge
8462            // is judged by the silence rule instead, never dropped silently and
8463            // never a boot refusal (`monitor::admit_contract_deadline`).
8464            let (qos, deadline_row) = super::monitor::admit_contract_deadline(
8465                qos,
8466                nros_rmw::Session::supported_qos_policies(session),
8467                age_table,
8468                req.topic_name,
8469            );
8470            let handle = session
8471                .create_subscription(&topic, qos)
8472                .map_err(NodeError::Transport)?;
8473            (handle, deadline_row)
8474        };
8475        if let Some(row) = deadline_row {
8476            row.cell
8477                .deadline_slot
8478                .store(slot as u32 + 1, core::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
8479            nros_log::log_info!(
8480                nros_log::get_logger("nros_node"),
8481                "qos: subscription '{}' deadline {} ms is judged by silence-runtime \
8482                 (the backend does not judge it)",
8483                req.topic_name,
8484                row.deadline_ms
8485            );
8486        }
8487        // Phase 231 Wave 0.2 (RFC-0038), phase-456 W8 — THE consulting site.
8488        // Deliberately `&&`-guarded by the delivery shape rather than by the
8489        // language: a shape that must hand the callback more than borrowed
8490        // bytes cannot use the capability however capable the backend is.
8491        let in_place = req.in_place_capable && {
8492            use nros_rmw::Subscription as _;
8493            handle.supports_process_in_place()
8494        };
8495        // phase-457 W3 — tell a metadata probe what this CALL SITE answered.
8496        //
8497        // `req.in_place_capable` and NOT `in_place`: the conjunction above
8498        // includes the backend a probe links, which is the RECORDING backend and
8499        // not the one the image ships. The sizing descriptor knows the shipped
8500        // backend from the image's `rmw` name and composes the two halves
8501        // itself; what it cannot see is this half, which is why nine of the
8502        // eleven registration entry points were previously credited with a
8503        // capability they do not have (issue 1340).
8504        //
8505        // AFTER the backend call, so a registration that failed reports
8506        // nothing — a row for a subscription that does not exist would raise the
8507        // probe's count, and an over-count of subscriptions is a real cost in
8508        // every pool that derives from it.
8509        #[cfg(feature = "registration-observer")]
8510        super::registration_observer::observe(super::registration_observer::ObservedRegistration {
8511            topic: topic.name,
8512            type_name: topic.type_name,
8513            in_place_capable: req.in_place_capable,
8514            // Issue 1648 -- the slot this registration is about to claim, read
8515            // off the request rather than inferred: `DEFAULT_RX_BUF_SIZE`
8516            // (`RX_BUF`) is the closure buffer (`unbounded`), anything else a
8517            // stated bound.
8518            claims_closure_buffer: req.slot_bytes == crate::config::DEFAULT_RX_BUF_SIZE,
8519        });
8520        Ok(SubscriptionOpen {
8521            slot,
8522            handle,
8523            qos,
8524            in_place,
8525            slot_bytes: req.slot_bytes,
8526        })
8527    }
8528
8529    /// Typed buffered subscription core (the `node_mut(id).subscription(t)
8530    /// .typed::<M>()` builder lowers here). Routes the typed subscription
8531    /// through the [`NodeId`]'s session + identity (rclcpp `add_node` pattern).
8532    ///
8533    /// Phase 403 W2 -- `rx_bytes` says how many bytes each buffer slot claims
8534    /// from the arena.
8535    ///
8536    /// phase-392 W3c -- `Some(n)` is verbatim; **`None` now means DERIVE from
8537    /// `M`**, falling back to `RX_BUF` only where no bound is reachable (an
8538    /// unbounded type, or a backend whose `MessageForRmw` carries no schema).
8539    /// It used to mean `RX_BUF` unconditionally, so a subscription that named no
8540    /// number was charged the global for every slot and a consumer who did not
8541    /// know `.rx_buffer_from_type()` existed paid it silently. The opt-out is
8542    /// now the explicit one: `.rx_buffer::<N>()` passes `Some(N)`.
8543    ///
8544    /// It is a RUNTIME `usize` and not a second const generic because on THIS
8545    /// path `RX_BUF` was never an array length -- it reaches
8546    /// `buffered_region_size`, `TripleBuffer::init` and `SpscRing::init`, all of
8547    /// which take a plain `usize`. That is the only reason W2's per-type sizing
8548    /// is expressible here at all: `Sub<{ M::BOUND }>` is
8549    /// `error: generic parameters may not be used in const operations` on stable
8550    /// (rustc 1.97.1), so the sibling `register_subscription_with_info_sized_inner`
8551    /// / `..._with_safety_sized_inner`, whose entries really do hold
8552    /// `[u8; RX_BUF]`, still need `nros::rx_buffer_for!` at the call site.
8553    pub(crate) fn register_subscription_buffered_on<M, F, const RX_BUF: usize>(
8554        &mut self,
8555        node_id: super::node_record::NodeId,
8556        topic_name: &str,
8557        qos: QoSProfile,
8558        callback: F,
8559        group: Option<&str>,
8560        rx_bytes: Option<usize>,
8561    ) -> Result<HandleId, NodeError>
8562    where
8563        M: crate::rmw_type_registry::MessageForRmw + 'static,
8564        F: FnMut(&M) + 'static,
8565    {
8566        type Entry<M, F> = SubBufferedEntry<M, F>;
8567
8568        // RFC-0088 / phase-421 W1 — the message's declared format must be the
8569        // one the linked backend speaks. Universal: the const lives on
8570        // `RosMessage`, which `MessageForRmw` requires under every backend.
8571        crate::format_check::assert_message_format::<M>();
8572        // Phase 212.K.7.6.b — see `create_publisher_on`.
8573        crate::rmw_type_registry::register_type::<M>()?;
8574
8575        // W3b.5 — contracted-endpoint age hook (None = free).
8576        let age_mon = self.age_lookup::<M>(topic_name);
8577
8578        // Phase 403 W2 -- one number for the whole allocation. The region size,
8579        // the strategy's slot size and the pointer arithmetic must agree, so
8580        // they read the same local rather than each spelling `RX_BUF`.
8581        //
8582        // phase-392 W3c -- and `None` no longer means `RX_BUF`, it means DERIVE.
8583        // This is the one choke point every default registration funnels
8584        // through, so putting the derivation here is what makes it the default
8585        // at all four of them (`create_subscription`, `create_subscription_in_group`,
8586        // the builder's `build()`, and the `/clock` time source) instead of at
8587        // whichever one a wave happened to touch. An explicit `Some(n)` -- what
8588        // `.rx_buffer::<N>()` and `.rx_buffer_from_type()` pass -- is still
8589        // verbatim, so the opt-out and the opt-in both bypass this line.
8590        let slot_bytes = crate::rmw_type_registry::subscription_slot_bytes::<M>(rx_bytes, RX_BUF);
8591
8592        let open = self.open_subscription(&SubscriptionRequest {
8593            node_id: Some(node_id),
8594            topic_name,
8595            type_name: <M as RosMessage>::TYPE_NAME,
8596            type_hash: <M as RosMessage>::TYPE_HASH,
8597            qos,
8598            // Phase 392 W3a — the TYPE's bound, not `RX_BUF`. The arena slot
8599            // size says nothing about the message: a 64-byte type and a 4 KiB
8600            // type both hinted the same number, so the class was chosen from a
8601            // value unrelated to what arrives. Falls back to `RX_BUF` for an
8602            // unbounded type, where no bound exists to state (phase 380).
8603            backend_hint: Some(crate::rmw_type_registry::subscription_rx_hint::<M>(RX_BUF)),
8604            slot_bytes,
8605            // A typed Rust callback takes `&M` and nothing else, so borrowed
8606            // bytes are enough: deserialize straight from the backend's slot.
8607            in_place_capable: true,
8608        })?;
8609        let SubscriptionOpen {
8610            slot,
8611            handle,
8612            qos,
8613            in_place,
8614            slot_bytes,
8615        } = open;
8616
8617        // Phase 231 Wave 0.2 (RFC-0038) — in-place dispatch when the backend
8618        // advertises it: deserialize straight from the borrowed receive slot,
8619        // no arena buffer (copy #1 removed). Else the buffered path below.
8620        if in_place {
8621            let entry_offset = self.arena_alloc::<SubInplaceEntry<M, F>>()?;
8622            unsafe {
8623                let arena_ptr = self.arena.as_mut_ptr() as *mut u8;
8624                let entry_ptr = arena_ptr.add(entry_offset) as *mut SubInplaceEntry<M, F>;
8625                core::ptr::write(
8626                    entry_ptr,
8627                    SubInplaceEntry {
8628                        handle,
8629                        callback,
8630                        age_mon,
8631                        _phantom: PhantomData,
8632                    },
8633                );
8634            }
8635            let meta = CallbackMeta {
8636                offset: entry_offset,
8637                kind: EntryKind::Subscription,
8638                arena_len: super::arena::ArenaLen::UNRECORDED,
8639                try_process: sub_inplace_try_process::<M, F>,
8640                has_data: sub_inplace_has_data::<M, F>,
8641                pre_sample: no_pre_sample,
8642                invocation: InvocationMode::OnNewData,
8643                drop_fn: drop_entry::<SubInplaceEntry<M, F>>,
8644            };
8645            self.emplace_entry(slot, meta, TraceName::Text(topic_name));
8646            // phase-397 W2 — this entry's arrivals mark its slot and wake this executor.
8647            // SAFETY: a `SubInplaceEntry<M, F>` was written at `entry_offset` just above.
8648            unsafe {
8649                self.arm_entry_wake::<SubInplaceEntry<M, F>>(slot, entry_offset, |e, w| {
8650                    nros_rmw::Subscription::register_waker(&e.handle, w)
8651                })
8652            };
8653            self.apply_node_default_sched(slot, Some(node_id), group);
8654            return Ok(self.handle_for(slot));
8655        }
8656
8657        let (_slot_count, trailing_bytes) = buffered_region_size(qos.depth, slot_bytes);
8658
8659        let (entry_offset, trailing_offset) =
8660            self.arena_alloc_with_trailing::<Entry<M, F>>(trailing_bytes)?;
8661
8662        let buf_ptr = unsafe { (self.arena.as_mut_ptr() as *mut u8).add(trailing_offset) };
8663
8664        let buffer = if qos.depth <= 1 {
8665            BufferStrategy::Triple(unsafe { TripleBuffer::init(buf_ptr, slot_bytes) })
8666        } else {
8667            BufferStrategy::Ring(unsafe { SpscRing::init(buf_ptr, slot_bytes, qos.depth as usize) })
8668        };
8669
8670        unsafe {
8671            let arena_ptr = self.arena.as_mut_ptr() as *mut u8;
8672            let entry_ptr = arena_ptr.add(entry_offset) as *mut Entry<M, F>;
8673            core::ptr::write(
8674                entry_ptr,
8675                Entry {
8676                    handle,
8677                    buffer,
8678                    callback,
8679                    age_mon,
8680                    _phantom: PhantomData,
8681                },
8682            );
8683        }
8684
8685        let meta = CallbackMeta {
8686            offset: entry_offset,
8687            kind: EntryKind::Subscription,
8688            arena_len: super::arena::ArenaLen::UNRECORDED,
8689            try_process: sub_buffered_try_process::<M, F>,
8690            has_data: sub_buffered_has_data::<M, F>,
8691            pre_sample: no_pre_sample,
8692            invocation: InvocationMode::OnNewData,
8693            drop_fn: drop_entry::<Entry<M, F>>,
8694        };
8695        self.emplace_entry(slot, meta, TraceName::Text(topic_name));
8696        // phase-397 W2 — this entry's arrivals mark its slot and wake this executor.
8697        // SAFETY: a `Entry<M, F>` was written at `entry_offset` just above.
8698        unsafe {
8699            self.arm_entry_wake::<Entry<M, F>>(slot, entry_offset, |e, w| {
8700                nros_rmw::Subscription::register_waker(&e.handle, w)
8701            })
8702        };
8703        // Phase 104.C.4 — apply Node's default SchedContext.
8704        self.apply_node_default_sched(slot, Some(node_id), group);
8705        Ok(self.handle_for(slot))
8706    }
8707
8708    /// Generic (type-erased) buffered subscription core (the
8709    /// `node_mut(id).subscription(t).generic(ty, hash)` builder lowers here).
8710    /// Routes the subscriber creation through the [`NodeId`]'s
8711    /// session + identity (rclcpp `add_node` pattern).
8712    ///
8713    /// Use this in bridge code where two Nodes bind to different RMW
8714    /// backends:
8715    ///
8716    /// ```ignore
8717    /// let node_in = exec.node_builder("ingress").rmw("zenoh").build()?;
8718    /// let pub_out = exec.with_node(node_out, |n| {
8719    ///     n.create_publisher_raw("/fwd", TYPE, HASH)
8720    /// })??;
8721    /// exec.register_subscription_buffered_raw_on::<_, 1024>(
8722    ///     node_in, "/src", TYPE, HASH, qos(),
8723    ///     move |bytes: &[u8]| { let _ = pub_out.publish_serialized(bytes); },
8724    /// )?;
8725    /// ```
8726    pub(crate) fn register_subscription_buffered_raw_on<F, const RX_BUF: usize>(
8727        &mut self,
8728        node_id: super::node_record::NodeId,
8729        topic_name: &str,
8730        type_name: &str,
8731        type_hash: &str,
8732        qos: QoSProfile,
8733        callback: F,
8734    ) -> Result<HandleId, NodeError>
8735    where
8736        F: FnMut(&[u8]) + 'static,
8737    {
8738        // Issue #52 — fold the node's baked overrides for this topic before the
8739        // backend-compat check runs inside `create_subscription`.
8740        //
8741        // **This is the one registration that does it**, which phase-456 W8
8742        // noticed while collapsing the twelve prologues into one and did NOT
8743        // change: the other eleven reach `create_subscription` with the QoS
8744        // their caller passed. Whether that is a defect or a deliberate limit
8745        // of the generic bridge path is a question with a measurable answer and
8746        // no answer here, so the asymmetry stays where it was, stated.
8747        let overrides = self
8748            .nodes
8749            .get(node_id.index())
8750            .ok_or(NodeError::InvalidSchedContextBinding)?
8751            .qos_overrides;
8752        let qos = super::node_record::apply_qos_override_codes(
8753            qos,
8754            topic_name,
8755            nros_rmw::QoSOverrideRole::Subscription,
8756            overrides,
8757        );
8758
8759        let SubscriptionOpen {
8760            slot,
8761            handle,
8762            qos,
8763            in_place,
8764            slot_bytes,
8765        } = self.open_subscription(&SubscriptionRequest {
8766            node_id: Some(node_id),
8767            topic_name,
8768            type_name,
8769            type_hash,
8770            qos,
8771            backend_hint: None,
8772            slot_bytes: RX_BUF,
8773            // Issue 1340 — `FnMut(&[u8])` IS a borrowed-bytes callback, which is
8774            // exactly what `process_raw_in_place` hands over, so this shape takes
8775            // the in-place row the way the C raw path does.
8776            //
8777            // This used to be `false` because the buffered entry is shared with
8778            // `Self::add_arena_subscription_callback` and "an in-place twin would
8779            // have to serve both". It does not: that caller supplies its own
8780            // subscriber and never reaches `open_subscription`, so no in-place
8781            // report can arrive there. The branch below is local to this entry
8782            // point, and the shared buffered emplace is untouched.
8783            //
8784            // phase-457 W5 (issue 1522) — spelled as the SHAPE rather than as a
8785            // literal, because the declarative registrar lowers here and the
8786            // metadata probe must state the same bool without registering. One
8787            // definition (`DeclaredSubscriptionShape::in_place_capable`), two
8788            // readers, so the row the build prices and the claim made here
8789            // moved together when it flipped.
8790            in_place_capable: super::declared_shape::DeclaredSubscriptionShape::BufferedRaw
8791                .in_place_capable(),
8792        })?;
8793
8794        if in_place {
8795            // No receive region: the backend's slot is the buffer for the
8796            // duration of the callback. This is the whole of issue 1340's saving
8797            // on the generic path — `buffered_region_size(depth, RX_BUF)` is
8798            // never reserved.
8799            type Entry<F> = super::arena::SubInplaceRawEntry<F>;
8800            let entry_offset = self.arena_alloc::<Entry<F>>()?;
8801            unsafe {
8802                let arena_ptr = self.arena.as_mut_ptr() as *mut u8;
8803                let entry_ptr = arena_ptr.add(entry_offset) as *mut Entry<F>;
8804                core::ptr::write(entry_ptr, Entry { handle, callback });
8805            }
8806            let meta = CallbackMeta {
8807                offset: entry_offset,
8808                kind: EntryKind::Subscription,
8809                arena_len: super::arena::ArenaLen::UNRECORDED,
8810                try_process: super::arena::sub_inplace_raw_try_process::<F>,
8811                has_data: super::arena::sub_inplace_raw_has_data::<F>,
8812                pre_sample: no_pre_sample,
8813                invocation: InvocationMode::OnNewData,
8814                drop_fn: drop_entry::<Entry<F>>,
8815            };
8816            // Same trace name as the buffered arm, so a trace reads the same
8817            // whichever dispatch the backend chose.
8818            self.emplace_entry(slot, meta, TraceName::Slot("sub", slot));
8819            // phase-397 W2 — this entry's arrivals mark its slot and wake this executor.
8820            // SAFETY: a `Entry<F>` was written at `entry_offset` just above.
8821            unsafe {
8822                self.arm_entry_wake::<Entry<F>>(slot, entry_offset, |e, w| {
8823                    nros_rmw::Subscription::register_waker(&e.handle, w)
8824                })
8825            };
8826        } else {
8827            self.emplace_raw_buffered_subscription(slot, handle, qos, slot_bytes, callback)?;
8828        }
8829        // Phase 104.C.4 — apply Node's default SchedContext.
8830        self.apply_node_default_sched(slot, Some(node_id), None);
8831        Ok(self.handle_for(slot))
8832    }
8833
8834    /// Register a borrowed (zero-copy) buffered subscription (Phase 229.6,
8835    /// issue 0007 / RFC-0033 `borrowed` mode).
8836    ///
8837    /// `B` is the code-generated borrowed-message marker (e.g. `ImageViewable`)
8838    /// implementing [`ViewableMessage`](nros_core::ViewableMessage); the
8839    /// callback receives `&B::View<'a>` — a lifetime-carrying message whose
8840    /// unbounded sequence/string fields borrow directly from the receive buffer
8841    /// (no `heapless::Vec` copy). The view is valid only for the callback's
8842    /// duration.
8843    ///
8844    /// **Triple-buffer only.** A borrowed view must reference exactly one
8845    /// well-defined buffer slot for the callback's duration; an SPSC ring
8846    /// (`qos.depth > 1`) keeps several samples in flight with no single such
8847    /// slot. `qos.depth > 1` is therefore rejected with
8848    /// [`TransportError::Unsupported`].
8849    pub(crate) fn register_subscription_buffered_borrowed_on<B, F, const RX_BUF: usize>(
8850        &mut self,
8851        node_id: super::node_record::NodeId,
8852        topic_name: &str,
8853        qos: QoSProfile,
8854        callback: F,
8855    ) -> Result<HandleId, NodeError>
8856    where
8857        B: nros_core::ViewableMessage + 'static,
8858        F: for<'a> FnMut(&B::View<'a>) + 'static,
8859    {
8860        type Entry<B, F> = SubBufferedViewEntry<B, F>;
8861
8862        // Borrowed views require a single well-defined slot (triple buffer).
8863        if qos.depth > 1 {
8864            return Err(NodeError::Transport(TransportError::Unsupported));
8865        }
8866
8867        let SubscriptionOpen { slot, handle, .. } =
8868            self.open_subscription(&SubscriptionRequest {
8869                node_id: Some(node_id),
8870                topic_name,
8871                type_name: <B as ViewableMessage>::TYPE_NAME,
8872                type_hash: <B as ViewableMessage>::TYPE_HASH,
8873                qos,
8874                backend_hint: None,
8875                slot_bytes: RX_BUF,
8876                // The view borrows the arena's own triple-buffer slot for the
8877                // callback's duration and `ViewableMessage::deserialize_view` is
8878                // what produces it, so there is no `FnMut(&[u8])` here to hand a
8879                // backend slot to. Making this shape in-place is a real option and
8880                // a separate change: it would move the borrow from the arena to the
8881                // backend's ring, which is a lifetime argument this item did not
8882                // make.
8883                in_place_capable: false,
8884            })?;
8885
8886        let (_slot_count, trailing_bytes) = buffered_region_size(qos.depth, RX_BUF);
8887        let (entry_offset, trailing_offset) =
8888            self.arena_alloc_with_trailing::<Entry<B, F>>(trailing_bytes)?;
8889        let buf_ptr = unsafe { (self.arena.as_mut_ptr() as *mut u8).add(trailing_offset) };
8890
8891        // depth <= 1 guaranteed above → always triple buffer.
8892        let buffer = BufferStrategy::Triple(unsafe { TripleBuffer::init(buf_ptr, RX_BUF) });
8893
8894        unsafe {
8895            let arena_ptr = self.arena.as_mut_ptr() as *mut u8;
8896            let entry_ptr = arena_ptr.add(entry_offset) as *mut Entry<B, F>;
8897            core::ptr::write(
8898                entry_ptr,
8899                Entry {
8900                    handle,
8901                    buffer,
8902                    callback,
8903                    _phantom: PhantomData,
8904                },
8905            );
8906        }
8907
8908        let meta = CallbackMeta {
8909            offset: entry_offset,
8910            kind: EntryKind::Subscription,
8911            arena_len: super::arena::ArenaLen::UNRECORDED,
8912            try_process: sub_buffered_view_try_process::<B, F>,
8913            has_data: sub_buffered_view_has_data::<B, F>,
8914            pre_sample: no_pre_sample,
8915            invocation: InvocationMode::OnNewData,
8916            drop_fn: drop_entry::<Entry<B, F>>,
8917        };
8918        self.emplace_entry(slot, meta, TraceName::Text(topic_name));
8919        // phase-397 W2 — this entry's arrivals mark its slot and wake this executor.
8920        // SAFETY: a `Entry<B, F>` was written at `entry_offset` just above.
8921        unsafe {
8922            self.arm_entry_wake::<Entry<B, F>>(slot, entry_offset, |e, w| {
8923                nros_rmw::Subscription::register_waker(&e.handle, w)
8924            })
8925        };
8926        self.apply_node_default_sched(slot, Some(node_id), None);
8927        Ok(self.handle_for(slot))
8928    }
8929
8930    /// Register a raw (type-erased) buffered subscription whose callback
8931    /// also receives a [`RawMessageInfo`](nros_core::RawMessageInfo)
8932    /// carrying the sample's wire **attachment** (Phase 189.M1).
8933    ///
8934    /// Backs the `node.subscription(t).generic(..).message_info().build(cb)`
8935    /// builder — the cross-RMW bridge reads the `bridge_origin` tag from
8936    /// `info.attachment()` for echo suppression. One sample per
8937    /// `spin_once`; the attachment is staged in a flat per-entry buffer
8938    /// (cap `RAW_INFO_ATT_CAP`).
8939    pub fn register_subscription_buffered_raw_info_on<F, const RX_BUF: usize>(
8940        &mut self,
8941        node_id: super::node_record::NodeId,
8942        topic_name: &str,
8943        type_name: &str,
8944        type_hash: &str,
8945        qos: QoSProfile,
8946        callback: F,
8947    ) -> Result<HandleId, NodeError>
8948    where
8949        F: FnMut(&[u8], &nros_core::RawMessageInfo) + 'static,
8950    {
8951        type Entry<F> = SubBufferedRawInfoEntry<F>;
8952
8953        let SubscriptionOpen {
8954            slot,
8955            handle,
8956            slot_bytes,
8957            ..
8958        } = self.open_subscription(&SubscriptionRequest {
8959            node_id: Some(node_id),
8960            topic_name,
8961            type_name,
8962            type_hash,
8963            qos,
8964            backend_hint: None,
8965            slot_bytes: RX_BUF,
8966            // The callback also receives the sample's wire ATTACHMENT, which
8967            // `process_raw_in_place` does not carry: it hands over borrowed
8968            // payload bytes and nothing else. Not a limitation of the backend.
8969            in_place_capable: false,
8970        })?;
8971
8972        // Issue 1860 -- in the trailing region, as the C twin. A raw subscription
8973        // has no type to derive from, so the size is still `RX_BUF`.
8974        let (offset, trailing) = self.arena_alloc_with_trailing::<Entry<F>>(slot_bytes)?;
8975        unsafe {
8976            let arena_ptr = self.arena.as_mut_ptr() as *mut u8;
8977            let buffer = super::arena::TrailingBuf::init(arena_ptr.add(trailing), slot_bytes);
8978            let entry_ptr = arena_ptr.add(offset) as *mut Entry<F>;
8979            core::ptr::write(
8980                entry_ptr,
8981                Entry {
8982                    handle,
8983                    buffer,
8984                    att: [0u8; super::arena::RAW_INFO_ATT_CAP],
8985                    callback,
8986                },
8987            );
8988        }
8989
8990        let meta = CallbackMeta {
8991            offset,
8992            kind: EntryKind::Subscription,
8993            arena_len: super::arena::ArenaLen::UNRECORDED,
8994            try_process: sub_buffered_raw_info_try_process::<F>,
8995            has_data: sub_buffered_raw_info_has_data::<F>,
8996            pre_sample: no_pre_sample,
8997            invocation: InvocationMode::OnNewData,
8998            drop_fn: drop_entry::<Entry<F>>,
8999        };
9000        self.emplace_entry(slot, meta, TraceName::Text(topic_name));
9001        // phase-397 W2 — this entry's arrivals mark its slot and wake this executor.
9002        // SAFETY: a `Entry<F>` was written at `offset` just above.
9003        unsafe {
9004            self.arm_entry_wake::<Entry<F>>(slot, offset, |e, w| {
9005                nros_rmw::Subscription::register_waker(&e.handle, w)
9006            })
9007        };
9008        self.apply_node_default_sched(slot, Some(node_id), None);
9009        Ok(self.handle_for(slot))
9010    }

9012    /// Phase 250 (Wave 2) — register a generic (type-erased) raw subscription

9031        F: FnMut(&[u8], &nros_rmw::IntegrityStatus) + 'static,

9067            let entry_ptr = arena_ptr.add(offset) as *mut Entry<F>;

9071                    handle,
9072                    buffer,

9079            offset,
9080            kind: EntryKind::Subscription,
9081            arena_len: super::arena::ArenaLen::UNRECORDED,
9082            try_process: sub_buffered_raw_safety_try_process::<F>,
9083            has_data: sub_buffered_raw_safety_has_data::<F>,
9084            pre_sample: no_pre_sample,

9100    /// Register a raw byte-shaped callback against a pre-built
9101    /// `RmwSubscriber` handle.
9102    ///
9103    /// Backend-agnostic primitive — the caller is responsible for
9104    /// obtaining the handle by whatever route the active backend
9105    /// supports:
9106    ///
9107    /// - **Generic ROS-typed flow**: call `Session::create_subscription`
9108    ///   on `self.session_mut()` with a [`TopicInfo`]. The
9109    ///   `node_mut(id).subscription(t).generic(ty, hash)` builder is the
9110    ///   convenience wrapper for this path.
9111    /// - **Backend-specific flow** (e.g. uORB needs `&'static orb_metadata`):
9112    ///   reach into the concrete session via [`Self::session_mut`] and
9113    ///   call its backend-specific create method, then hand the handle
9114    ///   here. `nros-px4::uorb::create_subscription_with_callback` is
9115    ///   the example.
9116    ///
9117    /// The arena-store + vtable wiring is identical to
9118    /// `register_subscription_buffered_raw`; the only thing that varies is
9119    /// where the handle came from. Callback fires on every message
9120    /// delivery during [`spin_once`](Self::spin_once); bytes are
9121    /// passed as `&[u8]`.
9122    pub fn add_arena_subscription_callback<F, const RX_BUF: usize>(
9123        &mut self,
9124        handle: session::RmwSubscriber,
9125        qos: QoSProfile,
9126        callback: F,
9127    ) -> Result<HandleId, NodeError>
9128    where
9129        F: FnMut(&[u8]) + 'static,
9130    {
9131        let slot = self.next_entry_slot()?;
9132        self.emplace_raw_buffered_subscription(slot, handle, qos, RX_BUF, callback)?;
9133        Ok(self.handle_for(slot))
9134    }
9135
9136    /// Write a raw buffered subscription entry into an already-claimed slot —
9137    /// phase-456 W8.
9138    ///
9139    /// The shared tail of [`Self::add_arena_subscription_callback`] and
9140    /// `register_subscription_buffered_raw_on`, which differ only in where the
9141    /// subscriber came from: one is handed a live `RmwSubscriber`, the other
9142    /// resolves a topic through [`Self::open_subscription`] and gets one back.
9143    /// Both then build exactly this entry, and they used to build it twice —
9144    /// the bridge path by CALLING the other, which meant it claimed a slot,
9145    /// resolved a topic, and then let the callee claim a second slot it did not
9146    /// need.
9147    fn emplace_raw_buffered_subscription<F>(
9148        &mut self,
9149        slot: usize,
9150        handle: session::RmwSubscriber,
9151        qos: QoSProfile,
9152        slot_bytes: usize,
9153        callback: F,
9154    ) -> Result<(), NodeError>
9155    where
9156        F: FnMut(&[u8]) + 'static,
9157    {
9158        type Entry<F> = SubBufferedRawEntry<F>;
9159
9160        let (_slot_count, trailing_bytes) = buffered_region_size(qos.depth, slot_bytes);
9161
9162        let (entry_offset, trailing_offset) =
9163            self.arena_alloc_with_trailing::<Entry<F>>(trailing_bytes)?;
9164
9165        let buf_ptr = unsafe { (self.arena.as_mut_ptr() as *mut u8).add(trailing_offset) };
9166
9167        let buffer = if qos.depth <= 1 {
9168            BufferStrategy::Triple(unsafe { TripleBuffer::init(buf_ptr, slot_bytes) })
9169        } else {
9170            BufferStrategy::Ring(unsafe { SpscRing::init(buf_ptr, slot_bytes, qos.depth as usize) })
9171        };
9172
9173        unsafe {
9174            let arena_ptr = self.arena.as_mut_ptr() as *mut u8;
9175            let entry_ptr = arena_ptr.add(entry_offset) as *mut Entry<F>;
9176            core::ptr::write(
9177                entry_ptr,
9178                Entry {
9179                    handle,
9180                    buffer,
9181                    callback,
9182                },
9183            );
9184        }
9185
9186        let meta = CallbackMeta {
9187            offset: entry_offset,
9188            kind: EntryKind::Subscription,
9189            arena_len: super::arena::ArenaLen::UNRECORDED,
9190            try_process: sub_buffered_raw_try_process::<F>,
9191            has_data: sub_buffered_raw_has_data::<F>,
9192            pre_sample: no_pre_sample,
9193            invocation: InvocationMode::OnNewData,
9194            drop_fn: drop_entry::<Entry<F>>,
9195        };
9196        self.emplace_entry(slot, meta, TraceName::Slot("sub", slot));
9197        // phase-397 W2 — this entry's arrivals mark its slot and wake this executor.
9198        // SAFETY: a `Entry<F>` was written at `entry_offset` just above.
9199        unsafe {
9200            self.arm_entry_wake::<Entry<F>>(slot, entry_offset, |e, w| {
9201                nros_rmw::Subscription::register_waker(&e.handle, w)
9202            })
9203        };
9204        Ok(())
9205    }

9207    pub(crate) fn register_subscription_with_info_sized_inner<M, F, const RX_BUF: usize>(
9208        &mut self,
9209        node_id: Option<super::node_record::NodeId>,
9210        topic_name: &str,
9211        qos: QoSProfile,
9212        callback: F,
9213        // Issue 1860 -- `Some(n)` is a size the caller NAMED (`.rx_buffer::<N>()`),
9214        // used verbatim; `None` derives it from `M` exactly as the buffered path
9215        // does, falling back to `RX_BUF` only where `M` states no bound.
9216        rx_bytes: Option<usize>,

9218    where
9219        M: crate::rmw_type_registry::MessageForRmw + 'static,
9220        F: FnMut(&M, Option<&nros_core::MessageInfo>) + 'static,
9221    {
9222        type Entry<M, F> = SubInfoEntry<M, F>;
9223
9224        // Phase 212.K.7.6.b — see `create_publisher_on`.
9225        crate::rmw_type_registry::register_type::<M>()?;
9226
9227        let SubscriptionOpen {
9228            slot,
9229            handle,
9230            slot_bytes,
9231            ..
9232        } = self.open_subscription(&SubscriptionRequest {
9233            node_id,
9234            topic_name,

9236            type_hash: <M as RosMessage>::TYPE_HASH,
9237            qos,
9238            backend_hint: None,
9239            slot_bytes: crate::rmw_type_registry::subscription_slot_bytes::<M>(rx_bytes, RX_BUF),
9240            // The entry's `pre_sample` hook stages a `MessageInfo` beside the
9241            // payload before the callback runs; an in-place drain has no
9242            // pre-sample step to hang it on.
9243            in_place_capable: false,
9244        })?;
9245
9246        let (offset, trailing) = self.arena_alloc_with_trailing::<Entry<M, F>>(slot_bytes)?;
9247
9248        unsafe {
9249            let arena_ptr = self.arena.as_mut_ptr() as *mut u8;

9251            let entry_ptr = arena_ptr.add(offset) as *mut Entry<M, F>;
9252            core::ptr::write(
9253                entry_ptr,
9254                Entry {
9255                    handle,
9256                    buffer,
9257                    sampled_len: 0,
9258                    callback,
9259                    _phantom: PhantomData,
9260                },
9261            );
9262        }
9263
9264        let meta = CallbackMeta {
9265            offset,
9266            kind: EntryKind::Subscription,
9267            arena_len: super::arena::ArenaLen::UNRECORDED,
9268            try_process: sub_info_try_process::<M, F>,
9269            has_data: sub_info_has_data::<M, F>,
9270            pre_sample: sub_info_pre_sample::<M, F>,
9271            invocation: InvocationMode::OnNewData,
9272            drop_fn: drop_entry::<Entry<M, F>>,
9273        };
9274        self.emplace_entry(slot, meta, TraceName::Text(topic_name));
9275        // phase-397 W2 — this entry's arrivals mark its slot and wake this executor.
9276        // SAFETY: a `Entry<M, F>` was written at `offset` just above.
9277        unsafe {
9278            self.arm_entry_wake::<Entry<M, F>>(slot, offset, |e, w| {
9279                nros_rmw::Subscription::register_waker(&e.handle, w)
9280            })
9281        };
9282        self.apply_node_default_sched(slot, node_id, None);
9283        Ok(self.handle_for(slot))
9284    }

9363    /// Register a service callback with the default buffer size.
9364    ///
9365    /// The callback is stored in the arena and invoked during [`spin_once()`](Self::spin_once).
9366    pub fn register_service<Svc, F>(
9367        &mut self,
9368        service_name: &str,
9369        callback: F,
9370    ) -> Result<HandleId, NodeError>
9371    where
9372        Svc: RosService + 'static,
9373        Svc::Request: crate::rmw_type_registry::MessageForRmw,
9374        Svc::Reply: crate::rmw_type_registry::MessageForRmw,
9375        F: FnMut(&Svc::Request) -> Svc::Reply + 'static,
9376    {
9377        self.register_service_sized::<Svc, F, { crate::config::DEFAULT_RX_BUF_SIZE }, { crate::config::DEFAULT_RX_BUF_SIZE }>(service_name, callback)
9378    }
9379
9380    /// Register a service callback with custom request/reply buffer sizes.
9381    pub fn register_service_sized<Svc, F, const REQ_BUF: usize, const REPLY_BUF: usize>(
9382        &mut self,
9383        service_name: &str,
9384        callback: F,
9385    ) -> Result<HandleId, NodeError>
9386    where
9387        Svc: RosService + 'static,
9388        Svc::Request: crate::rmw_type_registry::MessageForRmw,
9389        Svc::Reply: crate::rmw_type_registry::MessageForRmw,
9390        F: FnMut(&Svc::Request) -> Svc::Reply + 'static,
9391    {
9392        type Entry<Svc, F, const RQ: usize, const RP: usize> = SrvEntry<Svc, F, RQ, RP>;
9393
9394        // Phase 212.K.7.7.b — register both halves of the service round-trip
9395        // under cyclonedds. No-op for other RMWs. Mirrors the K.7.6.b hook
9396        // on `Node::create_service_sized`.
9397        crate::rmw_type_registry::register_type::<Svc::Request>()?;
9398        crate::rmw_type_registry::register_type::<Svc::Reply>()?;
9399
9400        let slot = self.next_entry_slot()?;
9401        let node_name: heapless::String<64> = self.node_name.clone();
9402        let ns: heapless::String<64> = self.namespace.clone();
9403        let mut info = ServiceInfo::new(service_name, Svc::SERVICE_NAME, Svc::SERVICE_HASH)
9404            .with_domain(self.domain_id)
9405            .with_namespace(&ns);
9406        if !node_name.is_empty() {
9407            info = info.with_node_name(&node_name);
9408        }
9409        let handle = self
9410            .session
9411            .create_service(&info, QoSProfile::services_default())
9412            .map_err(NodeError::Transport)?;
9413
9414        let offset = self.arena_alloc::<Entry<Svc, F, REQ_BUF, REPLY_BUF>>()?;
9415
9416        // SAFETY: same guarantees as register_subscription_sized.
9417        unsafe {
9418            let arena_ptr = self.arena.as_mut_ptr() as *mut u8;
9419            let entry_ptr = arena_ptr.add(offset) as *mut Entry<Svc, F, REQ_BUF, REPLY_BUF>;
9420            core::ptr::write(
9421                entry_ptr,
9422                Entry {
9423                    handle,
9424                    req_buffer: [0u8; REQ_BUF],
9425                    reply_buffer: [0u8; REPLY_BUF],
9426                    callback,
9427                    _phantom: PhantomData,
9428                },
9429            );
9430        }
9431
9432        let meta = CallbackMeta {
9433            offset,
9434            kind: EntryKind::Service,
9435            arena_len: super::arena::ArenaLen::UNRECORDED,
9436            try_process: srv_try_process::<Svc, F, REQ_BUF, REPLY_BUF>,
9437            has_data: srv_has_data::<Svc, F, REQ_BUF, REPLY_BUF>,
9438            pre_sample: no_pre_sample,
9439            invocation: InvocationMode::OnNewData,
9440            drop_fn: drop_entry::<Entry<Svc, F, REQ_BUF, REPLY_BUF>>,
9441        };
9442        self.emplace_entry(slot, meta, TraceName::Text(service_name));
9443        // phase-397 W2 — this entry's arrivals mark its slot and wake this executor.
9444        // SAFETY: a `Entry<Svc, F, REQ_BUF, REPLY_BUF>` was written at `offset` just above.
9445        unsafe {
9446            self.arm_entry_wake::<Entry<Svc, F, REQ_BUF, REPLY_BUF>>(slot, offset, |e, w| {
9447                nros_rmw::ServiceTrait::register_waker(&e.handle, w)
9448            })
9449        };
9450        Ok(self.handle_for(slot))
9451    }
9452
9453    /// Phase 104.C.3.3.a — Node-aware variant of
9454    /// [`register_service_sized`](Self::register_service_sized).
9455    pub fn register_service_sized_on<Svc, F, const REQ_BUF: usize, const REPLY_BUF: usize>(
9456        &mut self,
9457        node_id: super::node_record::NodeId,
9458        service_name: &str,

9460        callback: F,

9463        Svc: RosService + 'static,

9467    {
9468        self.register_service_sized_on_inner::<Svc, F, REQ_BUF, REPLY_BUF>(
9469            node_id,

9473            srv_try_process::<Svc, F, REQ_BUF, REPLY_BUF>,

9477    /// Issue 1942 — [`register_service_sized_on`](Self::register_service_sized_on)
9478    /// for a callback that also receives the request's
9479    /// [`ServiceInfo`](nros_core::ServiceInfo) — rclrs's `(request, ServiceInfo)`
9480    /// service callback. A field the backend cannot report arrives as `None`.
9481    pub fn register_service_with_info_sized_on<
9482        Svc,
9483        F,
9484        const REQ_BUF: usize,
9485        const REPLY_BUF: usize,
9486    >(
9487        &mut self,

9494        Svc: RosService + 'static,

9497        F: FnMut(&Svc::Request, &nros_core::ServiceInfo) -> Svc::Reply + 'static,
9498    {
9499        self.register_service_sized_on_inner::<Svc, F, REQ_BUF, REPLY_BUF>(

9508    /// The one body behind both callback shapes: they share [`SrvEntry`] and
9509    /// differ only in the dispatch function.
9510    fn register_service_sized_on_inner<Svc, F, const REQ_BUF: usize, const REPLY_BUF: usize>(
9511        &mut self,
9512        node_id: super::node_record::NodeId,
9513        service_name: &str,
9514        qos: QoSProfile,
9515        callback: F,
9516        try_process: unsafe fn(*mut u8, u64, u8) -> Result<bool, TransportError>,
9517    ) -> Result<HandleId, NodeError>
9518    where
9519        Svc: RosService + 'static,
9520        Svc::Request: crate::rmw_type_registry::MessageForRmw,
9521        Svc::Reply: crate::rmw_type_registry::MessageForRmw,
9522        F: 'static,
9523    {
9524        type Entry<Svc, F, const RQ: usize, const RP: usize> = SrvEntry<Svc, F, RQ, RP>;
9525
9526        // Phase 212.K.7.7.b — see `register_service_sized`.
9527        crate::rmw_type_registry::register_type::<Svc::Request>()?;
9528        crate::rmw_type_registry::register_type::<Svc::Reply>()?;
9529
9530        let slot = self.next_entry_slot()?;
9531        let (node_name, ns, session_idx) = {
9532            let r = self
9533                .nodes
9534                .get(node_id.index())
9535                .ok_or(NodeError::InvalidSchedContextBinding)?;
9536            (r.name.clone(), r.namespace.clone(), r.session_idx)
9537        };
9538        let mut info = ServiceInfo::new(service_name, Svc::SERVICE_NAME, Svc::SERVICE_HASH)
9539            .with_domain(self.domain_id)
9540            .with_namespace(&ns);
9541        if !node_name.is_empty() {
9542            info = info.with_node_name(&node_name);
9543        }
9544        let handle = {
9545            let session = self
9546                .session_at_mut(session_idx)
9547                .ok_or(NodeError::BackendMismatch)?;
9548            // Phase 193.5 — validate against the backend's supported policies
9549            // (no silent downgrade); request/reply effectively requires RELIABLE.
9550            super::node::validate_qos_or_report(
9551                &qos,
9552                session.supported_qos_policies(),
9553                "service",
9554                service_name,
9555            )?;
9556            session
9557                .create_service(&info, qos)
9558                .map_err(NodeError::Transport)?
9559        };
9560
9561        let offset = self.arena_alloc::<Entry<Svc, F, REQ_BUF, REPLY_BUF>>()?;
9562        unsafe {
9563            let arena_ptr = self.arena.as_mut_ptr() as *mut u8;
9564            let entry_ptr = arena_ptr.add(offset) as *mut Entry<Svc, F, REQ_BUF, REPLY_BUF>;
9565            core::ptr::write(
9566                entry_ptr,
9567                Entry {
9568                    handle,
9569                    req_buffer: [0u8; REQ_BUF],
9570                    reply_buffer: [0u8; REPLY_BUF],
9571                    callback,
9572                    _phantom: PhantomData,
9573                },
9574            );
9575        }
9576
9577        let meta = CallbackMeta {
9578            offset,
9579            kind: EntryKind::Service,
9580            arena_len: super::arena::ArenaLen::UNRECORDED,
9581            try_process,
9582            has_data: srv_has_data::<Svc, F, REQ_BUF, REPLY_BUF>,
9583            pre_sample: no_pre_sample,
9584            invocation: InvocationMode::OnNewData,
9585            drop_fn: drop_entry::<Entry<Svc, F, REQ_BUF, REPLY_BUF>>,
9586        };
9587        self.emplace_entry(slot, meta, TraceName::Text(service_name));
9588        // phase-397 W2 — this entry's arrivals mark its slot and wake this executor.
9589        // SAFETY: a `Entry<Svc, F, REQ_BUF, REPLY_BUF>` was written at `offset` just above.
9590        unsafe {
9591            self.arm_entry_wake::<Entry<Svc, F, REQ_BUF, REPLY_BUF>>(slot, offset, |e, w| {
9592                nros_rmw::ServiceTrait::register_waker(&e.handle, w)
9593            })
9594        };
9595        self.apply_node_default_sched(slot, Some(node_id), None);
9596        Ok(self.handle_for(slot))
9597    }
